_CURRENT_SCOPE_NOTE: This JSON file targets the stable 1.x GUI path.
For the recommended GUI-only high-precision path, use config/pdf2zh_next.openai.toml with pdf2zh_next GUI instead.
_REQUIRED_USER_INPUT_BEFORE_USE: If you use the official OpenAI API, keep OPENAI_BASE_URL as https://api.openai.com/v1.
If you use an OpenAI-compatible proxy, change OPENAI_BASE_URL and make sure it ends with /v1.
This file is intended for the stable byaidu/pdf2zh Docker image, with OpenAI as the main path.
For final mathematical or scientific papers, use OpenAI as the translator profile here, but prefer the GUI precise path once a one-page sanity check has passed.
_QUALITY_FIRST_MODEL_NOTE: gpt-4.1-mini is kept here as the broad-compatibility starting point because it is the documented default.
For final mathematical-paper runs, if your environment supports a stronger OpenAI-compatible model that you trust more, replace OPENAI_MODEL after the one-page smoke test.
_GUI_FIELDS_NOT_CONTROLLED_BY_THIS_FILE: Translation Mode (fast/precise) is a GUI choice in stable 1.x and is not persisted here.
number of threads is a GUI textbox defaulting in the app, not a value controlled by this file.
Pages, Ignore cache, and Skip font subsetting are GUI runtime choices, not persistent config keys in stable 1.x.
_HIGH_PRECISION_GUI_NOTES: Stable 1.x GUI exposes Custom formula font regex via PDF2ZH_VFONT, but it does not expose a formula character regex field.
When you change formula regex or switch between fast and precise, turn on Ignore cache in the GUI for the next run.
For the first mathematical-paper validation run, use Pages=First and threads=1.
After the first sanity check passes, you can retry the real run in precise mode for higher layout fidelity.
_FORMULA_REGEX_SOURCE_NOTE: The PDF2ZH_VFONT value below follows the stronger formula-font preservation pattern documented by the project.
Its role is to reduce accidental translation of mathematical glyph runs that are better preserved as formulas.
_STABLE_GUI_LIMITATIONS_FOR_HIGH_PRECISI: Stable 1.x GUI does not expose many pdf2zh_next/BabelDOC quality knobs such as glossary files, OCR workaround policy, table-text translation, primary font family, or compatibility bundles as persistent config keys.
Within stable GUI-only operation, the most actionable precision levers are service choice, page scope, threads, Ignore cache, Translation Mode, and PDF2ZH_VFONT.
_NOTES: Stable GUI may still show Google and Bing even when ENABLED_SERVICES contains only OpenAI.
HIDDEN_GRADIO_DETAILS hides API keys in the GUI, but it does not encrypt them in this file.
